missed.part: ADS1220IPWR (LCSC C48263); also ADS1220IRVAR (C2651338), and the 16-bit ADS1120IPWR (C84284)
missed.why: A family P2 did not consider. It is a general 24-bit ADC like the ADS1118 that P2 dropped, but it detects an open thermocouple on chip. SBAS501D section 8.3.10 (Sensor Detection) gives 10 µA burn-out current sources (BCS bit): an open sensor pulls AINP to AVDD and AINN to AVSS, so the reading goes full scale. That meets V250 with no added resistor. Supply: AVDD 2.3 to 5.5 V, so it runs on 3.3 V. The internal temperature sensor for cold-junction compensation is ±0.5 °C max over TA 0 to 75 °C (Electrical Characteristics), which covers V251's 0 to 50 °C. Data rates run 20 to 2,000 samples/s, so V236's one reading per 2,000 ms is met. It is on SPI. Linearisation is left to firmware for any thermocouple type, which fits V233 (type not found). Input absolute maximum is AVSS - 0.3 V to AVDD + 0.3 V, so like every other candidate it depends on round 2's protection for V237.
